mentions.name: Zendux AI
mentions.description: This AI-powered advertising platform generates multiple ad variants (angles, messages, layouts, formats) from a single brief, launches them on platforms like Meta Ads, and automates campaign testing and management using rules and scheduled workflows similar to cron jobs. It evolved from a collection of ad-creation and campaign-management scripts.
mentions.problem: Paid advertising has become competitive and expensive; companies spend money on ads and get poor results because running effective campaigns requires significant experimentation, creative work, and ongoing optimization.
mentions.audience: Marketing teams and companies that run paid advertising campaigns, including software businesses launching new products.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The result is Zendux AI (https://zenduxai.com).

The idea is simple: instead of manually creating dozens of ads, users can generate different angles, messages, layouts, and formats from a single brief. They can then launch those ads on platforms like Meta Ads and automate parts of the testing process using rules and scheduled workflows, similar to cron jobs.
